fixed_point_choices.rounding: round half away from zero, for S*lambda and for (1 - gamma)*M
fixed_point_choices.saturation: bias and stored marginal clip to +-(2^N - 1); nu clips to the same range
fixed_point_choices.accumulator: exact (no overflow): sigma and every partial sum
fixed_point_choices.alpha: alpha*x = x - (x >> k); adaptive: k = t + 1, t = iteration index within the leg
fixed_point_choices.memory_strength: beta_int = round((1 - gamma) M) clipped to [0, 2M]; gamma*x = x - beta(x)x
fixed_point_choices.multiplier: beta(x)x = sign(x) sum_{bit b of |x|} floor(beta_int 2^b / M)
fixed_point_choices.first_iteration: the first check pass of every leg reads lambda_int (messages restart from the priors)
fixed_point_choices.marginal_init: M = lambda_int at the start of a decode; kept from leg to leg
fixed_point_choices.weight: sum of lambda_int over the support, divided by S once

arrays.detectors: uint8 [S, Rt*M]: the detector stream of each shot, round after round (row (r - 1)*M + i is check i of round r)
arrays.observables: uint8 [S, k]: the true logical observable flips
arrays.shape_rows, shape_columns: uint32 [num_shapes]: local window size of each shape
arrays.shape<i>_H_indptr, shape<i>_H_indices: uint32: the window check matrix H~ of shape i (local CSR, rows in round order)
arrays.shape<i>_lambda: int8 [n_i]: quantised priors lambda_int = sat(round(S ln((1 - p)/p)))
arrays.shape<i>_commit: uint8 [n_i]: commit mask m_com (1 = the column is decided by this window)
arrays.shape<i>_converge: uint8 [rows_i]: convergence mask (1 = H~ e = s must hold on this row)
arrays.shape<i>_frame: uint64 [n_i]: frame matrix A~ by column: bit o = logical observable o flipped (0 for uncommitted columns)
arrays.shape<i>_beta: uint8 [T, n_i]: beta_int = round((1 - gamma) M) of relay leg r >= 1 (row r mod T); leg 0 uses beta(gamma0)
arrays.placement<k>_<a>_columns: uint32 [n]: global column of each local column (0xFFFFFFFF = virtual, uniform boundary)
arrays.win_attempts: uint8 [S, K]: attempts decoded at window position k (0 = skipped after a final placement)
arrays.win_iterations, win_legs: uint32 [S, K]: BP iterations and relay legs, summed over the attempts
arrays.win_converged, win_cap_hit, win_flagged: uint8 [S, K]: outcome of the committed attempt
arrays.win_carry: uint8 [S, K, M]: the window's first-round detectors after the carry of earlier commits (Algorithm 2's d~[0:M] xor u)
arrays.win_frame: uint64 [S, K]: accumulated logical frame after the window (bit o = observable o)
arrays.solution_ptr, solution_local: uint64 [S K + 1], uint32: the local support of the returned e of each window (committed attempt)
arrays.commit_local_ptr, commit_local: uint64 [S K + 1], uint32: local committed columns (e AND m_com) of each window
arrays.commit_ptr, commit_faults: uint64 [S K + 1], uint32: committed global columns of each window (virtual ones omitted)

stream: window k starts at round t_k = 1 + k C; its syndrome is the residual of rounds [t_k, t_k + rows/M) (rounds past Rt are zero); after decoding, e AND m_com is committed: its rows flip the residual and A~ e_com is XORed into the frame
reproduced: every array was reproduced by a second, single-process decode before writing
